description.zh:
返回结果中数据记录的排序方式，取值：

- **0**：倒序。
- **1**：正序。
description.en:
The sorting order for data records in the return result. Valid values:  
- **0**: Descending order.  
- **1**: Ascending order.

description.zh:
设备的名称。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
description.en:
The name of the device.  
><notice> If this parameter is specified, you must also specify **ProductKey**.  
></notice>

description.zh: 要查询的数据记录的结束时间，必须大于起始时间**StartTime**。取值为毫秒值时间戳，例如：1579249499000。
description.en: The end time of the data records to query. This value must be greater than the start time (**StartTime**). The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds, for example, 1579249499000.

description.zh: 已存储热数据中的字段标识符。即调用**WriteDevicesHotStorageData**接口写入热数据中请求参数**Items**中的字段标识符。
description.en: The field identifier of the stored hot data. This identifier corresponds to the field identifiers in the **Items** request parameter when you call the **WriteDevicesHotStorageData** API to write hot data.

description.zh:
设备ID。
><notice> **IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
description.en:
Device ID.  
><notice> **IotId** serves as the unique identifier of a device and has a one-to-one mapping relationship with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the **ProductKey**/**DeviceName** pair, **IotId** takes precedence.  
></notice>

description.zh: 实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。
description.en: Instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

description.zh: 下一页标识。如果存在下一页，服务会返回此token，下次请求带上即可。
description.en: The token for the next page. If a next page exists, the service returns this token. Include it in your next request.

description.zh:
单个字段标识符可返回的数据记录数量，最大值为100。

任意一个字段返回的数据记录数量均不超过该值。
description.en:
The maximum number of data records that can be returned for a single field identifier. The maximum value is 100.  
The number of data records returned for any field does not exceed this value.

description.zh:
设备所属的产品**ProductKey**。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
description.en:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.  
><notice> If this parameter is specified, you must also specify **DeviceName**.  
></notice>

description.zh: 要查询的数据记录的开始时间，必须小于结束时间**EndTime**。取值为毫秒值时间戳，例如：1579249499000。
description.en: The start time of the data records to query. This value must be less than the end time (**EndTime**). The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds, for example, 1579249499000.

description.zh:
要查询数据所属自定义Topic。从`user`类目开始，输入自定义Topic的后续所有类目。

自定义Topic详细说明，请参见[自定义Topic](~~85539~~)。
description.en:
The custom topic to which the queried data belongs. Enter all subsequent categories of the custom topic starting from the `user` category.  
For more information about custom topics, see [custom topic](~~85539~~).

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
仅标准型和尊享型企业版实例下，支持调用该接口查询热数据。

热数据存储详细说明，请参见[配置热数据存储](~~464047~~)。

## 使用限制
- 调用该接口的每秒请求写入数据数，由您购买实例下的**热数据存储IOPS**规格决定。详细内容，请参见[购买企业版实例](~~356507~~)和[查看热数据存储IOPS](~~464051~~)。

- 仅可查询存储时效内的数据。数据存储时效，请参见[存储配置](~~464050~~)。
    
    > 数据存储时间从存储字段的时间戳表示的时间当日开始计算。
descriptions.en:
## How-To
You can invoke this API to query hot data only for medium and premium Enterprise instances.

For more information about hot data storage, see [Storage Configuration](~~464047~~).

## Limits
- The number of data write requests per second allowed when invoking this API is determined by the **hot data storage input/output operations per second (IOPS)** specification of your purchased instance. For more information, see [Purchase an Enterprise Instance](~~356507~~) and [View Hot Data Storage IOPS](~~464051~~).

- You can query only data within its storage retention period. For details about data retention periods, see [Storage Configuration](~~464050~~).

    > The data retention period starts from the day corresponding to the UNIX timestamp of the stored field.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-devices-hot-storage-data --iot-instance-id iot-2w0000 --page-size 10 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name device1 --next-page-token Bo000x44Qx --start-time 1579249499000 --identifier temperature --asc 0 --iot-id y4u2weAI00000000HMle1234 --end-time 1579249499000 --user-topic user/a000/b000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot QueryDevicesHotStorageData --region cn-hangzhou --Asc 0 --IotId y4u2weAI00000000HMle1234 --Identifier temperature --IotInstanceId 'iot-2w0000' --PageSize 10 --EndTime 1579249499000 --UserTopic 'user/a000/b000' --NextPageToken Bo000x44Qx --StartTime 1579249499000 --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceName device1
